case_name: Bret Jason Harding v Terjon Services Pty Ltd
summary: Complex case involving a truck rollover on 19 July 2019, with criminal charges against Harding, civil litigation between Terjon and Harding, and subsequent TfNSW infrastructure damage claims. Key issues include VIN rebirthing allegations, retroactive employment documentation, dual representation concerns, and potential suppression of vehicle defect evidence.

timeline.description: Harding begins driving for Terjon after informal introduction
timeline.significance: No formal interview, no employment contract signed

timeline.description: Truck rollover accident on M5 East Motorway entrance
timeline.significance: Major infrastructure damage, Harding tests positive for methamphetamines

timeline.description: Joe Dimech signs internal incident report
HMIA deems truck a total loss but repairable write-off
timeline.significance: Truck valued as salvageable, not non-repairable

timeline.description: Terjon sues Harding in Local Court for truck damage
Local Court judgment for Terjon against Harding
timeline.significance: Court finds 'serious & wilful misconduct', rejects Employee Liability Act defence

timeline.description: Supreme Court appeal settled by consent
timeline.outcome: Costs order $31,743.91, caveat on Harding's property
timeline.significance: Harding withdraws appeal, agrees to property caveat

timeline.description: TfNSW files District Court suit against Harding & Terjon
timeline.significance: Infrastructure damage claim, both parties as co-defendants

timeline.description: TfNSW and Terjon sign Deed of Settlement
timeline.terms: Terjon pays $200,000, assigns judgment against Harding
timeline.significance: Harding not initially party to deed

timeline.description: Harding and TfNSW execute Deed of Settlement
timeline.significance: TfNSW agrees not to enforce beyond secured assets

timeline.terms: Transfer of Terjon's judgments to TfNSW
timeline.significance: Local Court ($85,345) and Supreme Court ($31,743.91) debts assigned

timeline.description: Consent Judgment entered by District Court
timeline.outcome: TfNSW judgment: $200k against Terjon, $110k against Harding
timeline.significance: Trial vacated, dual representation concerns arise

vin_rebirthing.description: Truck re-registered from CK89AJ to XO29MP after being written off
vin_rebirthing.significance: Possible VIN tampering and insurance fraud

media: Channel 7 video showing normal speed turn

employment_documentation.pre_accident: No written contract, no tax file declaration
employment_documentation.post_accident: Retroactively signed documents classifying as contractor
employment_documentation.conflicts: Terjon treated Harding as employee then contractor depending on context

key_documents.description: HMIA Assessor Report declaring repairable write-off
key_documents.significance: States truck has NOT suffered non-repairable damage

key_documents.findings: Drug impairment, but mechanical issues noted

affidavits.content: Claims accident caused by imbalanced load and ineffective brakes, not just drug use
contradictions: Conflicts with guilty plea admitting fault
Blames mechanical failure vs earlier admission

affidavits.content: Annexes HMIA report, discusses truck damage

issues.description: Dual representation - Storie consenting to judgment against own client while coordinating with opposing parties
issues.legal_basis: Legal professional conduct rules, fiduciary duty

issues.description: Retroactive creation of employment documents post-accident
Potential VIN rebirthing - truck re-registered after write-off
Immediate towing of wreck, 20+ defect notices not prosecuted
Questions about Harding's informed consent to settlement

contradictions.version1: Terjon claims Harding is employee for liability protection
contradictions.version2: Terjon claims Harding is contractor to avoid vicarious liability

contradictions.version1: Harding admits fault due to drug impairment (police statement)
contradictions.version2: Harding blames mechanical failure and load imbalance (affidavit)
Same VIN appears re-registered as XO29MP

human_rights_concerns: Right to fair trial - dual representation issues
Access to justice - potential coercion in settlement
forensic_concerns: Chain of custody for wrecked vehicle - immediate towing
Timeline of document creation - backdating evidence
